definitions.definition: Population who have been living in Maldives for more than one year or intends to live in Maldives for 1 year or more. This includes Resident Maldivian Population and Resident Foreign Population.
Maldivian who have been living in Maldives for more than one year or intends to live in Maldives for 1 year or more. Maldivians who are permanently living abroad is excluded from here
Foreigners who have living in Maldives for more than one year or intends to live in Maldives for 1 year or more. Foreigners such as tourists, short term stay is excluded from this count.
Includes the 4 wards of Maale (Henveiru, Galolhu, Machchangoalhi, Maafannu), Hulumaale, Villimaale, and K.Hulhule with harbour of these areas
Includes administrative islands and non-administrative islands
These are islands with islands/city councils.

Includes resorts and industrial islands and other islands. Industrial islands and other islands includes resorts under development, islands leased out for agricultural , fisheries purpose, etc. These islands are included if anyone lives and sleep there. It also includes Thilafushi and Gulheefalhu
The count of population in South Thiladhunmathi is including Kulhudhuffushi City
Maale Atoll includes only administrative islands within the atoll and excludes Maale (Maale', Villimaale, Hulhumaale, Hulhule)
Number of the Males per 100 Female in the population ( Males divided by Females x 100)

The rate at which a population is increasing (or decreasing) in a given year due to natural increase and net migration, expressed as a percentage of the base population. 
Formula:
= LN(current  census year population/ Previous census year population)/ time in between 2 census *100,
where:
Current census =382639
Previous census=338434
Time= 7.99
The demographic dependency ratio is a measure showing the number of dependents, aged 0-14 years and over the age of 65, to the working age group 15 to 64 years.
The child dependency ratio is the ratio of the population aged 0-14 to the population aged 15-64, presented as the number of dependents per 100 persons of working age (15-64).

The old-age-dependency ratio is the ratio of the number of elderly people at an age when they are generally economically inactive (i.e. aged 65 and over), compared to the number of people of working age (i.e. 15-64 years old).
Population density refers to the number of people living in an area per square kilometre or other unit of land area.

Median age is the age that divides a population into two numerically equal groups - that is, half the people are younger than this age and half are older. It is a single index that summarizes the age distribution of a population.
Working age population is the population aged 15 years and older
Labour force refers to the sum of all persons of working age who are employed and those who are unemployed.
Labour force participation rate expresses the labour force as a percentage of the working-age population.

definitions.term: Labour force participation rate = Labour force / Working-age population x 100 = (Persons employed + Persons unemployed) / Working-age population x 100
definitions.definition: Labour force participation rate = Labour force / Working-age population x 100 = (Persons employed + Persons unemployed) / Working-age population x 100
Employment-to-population ratio is defined as the proportion of a country’s working-age population that is employed.

definitions.term: Employment-to-population ratio = Persons employed / Working-age population x 100
definitions.definition: Employment-to-population ratio = Persons employed / Working-age population x 100
Unemployment rate is calculated by expressing the number of unemployed persons as a percentage of the total number of persons in the labour force.

definitions.term: Unemployment rate = Persons unemployed / Labour force = Persons unemployed / (Persons employed + Persons unemployed) x 100
definitions.definition: Unemployment rate = Persons unemployed / Labour force = Persons unemployed / (Persons employed + Persons unemployed) x 100

definitions.term: Combined rate of unemployment and potential labour force
definitions.definition: Combined rate of unemployment and potential labour force = [(Persons unemployed+potential labour force) / (extendedl abour force)] x 100
Inactivity rate is the proportion of the working-age population that is not in the labour force
youth unemployment rate is (youth unemployment as a percentage of the youth labour force)

definitions.term: Standard international definition of youth refers to persons aged 15 to 24. However, In Maldives context youth refers to persons aged 18 to 35.
definitions.definition: Standard international definition of youth refers to persons aged 15 to 24. However, In Maldives context youth refers to persons aged 18 to 35.

definitions.term: Rate of young people not in employment,education or training (NEET rate)
definitions.definition: The share of youth not in education, employment or training (also known as “the NEET rate”) conveys the number of young persons not in education, employment or training as a percentage of the total youth population.

definitions.term: NEET rate = (Youth – Youth in employment – Youth not in employment but in education or training) / Youth x 100
definitions.definition: NEET rate = (Youth – Youth in employment – Youth not in employment but in education or training) / Youth x 100

qualifications: Census indicators describe 2022 whole-island residents, not current neighbourhoods.
Age cohort counts and dependency ratios apply to resident Maldivians only. Age cohorts overlap and must not be added together.

Employment indicators are published percentages, not workers, riders or commutes. Rates require their own denominators and cannot be summed or population weighted using total residents; working age in the labour definitions is 15 years and older.
Island projections use the MBS ratio method to allocate atoll projections, with nationality and sex but no projected ages; projected 2022 is not the census count.
Malé city, resorts and industrial islands are outside these 186 indicator rows. An absent record means unavailable, not zero.
